title: leontodon oxylepis var. divaricatus
intro: Leontodon oxylepis var. divaricatus, commonly known as Mountain Hawk's Beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in supporting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The health benefits of Mountain Hawk's Beard include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
